change_definition.current_behavior: Move to All (sync-all move:true) copies source to every destination in parallel via sync/operations.moveFile (copy only); deferred deleteFile(source) after all destinations succeed. Same-volume destinations never use fs.rename.
change_definition.desired_behavior: Per-item MovePlan classifies volume affinity; executes cross-volume copies first, same-volume copies for extra same-volume targets, single same-volume rename last (rename target = lexicographically smallest same-volume destPath); omits deferred delete when final leg is rename; optional verify skip after atomic rename.
non_goals: Directory MovePlan unless NSYNC gains directory support
Hard-link optimization for duplicate same-volume dests
Progress UI for long cross-volume copies
success_criteria: buildMovePlan unit tests cover destination mix matrix and single-rename invariant
engine.test.ts mixed A+A+B uses one cross-volume copy, one rename, no deferred delete
pseudocode_validate and tied_validate_consistency pass after TIED writes
change_definition.unchanged_behavior: Copy to All; bulk-move single destination; observer/cancel/store monitor; compare skip per destination

record_identity.title: NSYNC hybrid move plan — rename where possible

counterexamples: Plan emits two rename legs for two same-volume destinations
Rename scheduled before all required copy legs complete

move-plan.test.ts shows count(rename) > 1 for K>=2 same-volume dests

falsification_questions: After cross-volume copy succeeds but rename fails, is source still present?
Can two rename legs be emitted when source volume matches multiple targets?
Does rename ever run before all required copies finish?
